propositions: A code-review finding raised on one patchset but not re-emitted on a later patchset reaches no consumer, causing undetected defects to merge and break downstream (e.g., macOS CI failure on change 1869).

Standing findings eligible for carry-forward must be surfaced-only (blocking or advisory), have non-empty evidence, and are classified by region hash comparison against the prior payload's deps: still-present (hash unchanged or unresolvable), addressed (hash changed), or withdrawn (already carried once).

Carried findings are injected post-Pass-1 into the merge_findings workflow input with their origin patchset and decision preserved, capped at 12 items by priority, and never re-emitted if the cited region changes.

The posture of a carried finding is clamped to at most its origin_decision (block or advisory) to prevent a defect that changed criterion between patchsets from raising a finding that was previously advisory back to blocking.

The reader (latest_code_review_result) is extended to return the revision number and stamp each surfaced finding with its bucket origin (blocking→block, advisory→advisory) so that standing.origin_decision defaults correctly.
Carry-forward is one-shot: an already-carried item classifies as withdrawn and is not carried again, so the chain terminates after a single patchset even if the cited region continues to change.
